convention: Rips threshold graph at t has edge {x,y} iff D(x,y) < t. Pair {a,b} is a certified failure at t when D(a,b)+tol < t <= min(innerF,innerR)-tol. The longest saved H1 bar is alive for t in (birth, death]. "before death": some certified t <= death; "while alive": some certified t in (birth, death]. Graphs without a certified pair are not certified failing; they are not claimed cyclic.

two_sat.scope: Exact orientation-consistency check (one orientation per edge) for the arc-supported single-bar ellipse graphs whose shorter-arc failure precedes the bar death: seven thresholds in (birth, first certified), first certified -1e-6 and +1e-9, the midpoint to the death, and the death.
